name: Ring of Pale Fortification
body:
Aura faint necromancy (healing); CL 5th; Slot ring; Price 10,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

Two entwined bands of silver form this ring, one brilliant and polished the other a tarnished black.

Wearing this ring allows you to tap into the powers of the pale to ward yourself from danger and to infuse your body with restorative magic. This ring holds 2 theology points that restore each night at midnight.

As long as there is at least one theology point stored within the ring, you gain a bonus on saving throws against death effects, disease, and poison equal to the number of theology points the ring holds.

As a swift action, you may spend 1 theology point to heal yourself for 3d8+5 points of damage. This healing is formed of pale energies, able to heal both living and undead creatures.

If you already have a pool of theology points this ring can also be used to store your theology points, up to a maximum of 2.

These points are stored until they are spent or until you remove the ring. These stored points are in addition to those the ring normally holds, and can be used normally while they are stored.

Resting to restore your theology points has no effect on those stored within the ring, allowing stored theology points to be carried over to the next day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells cure serious wounds, inflict serious wounds; Special creator must be able to use theology points; Cost 5,000 gp.
